_format: SVCv4 bundled classification envelope (illustrative). Statements and methods are declared ONCE in the `method` and `assessment` dictionaries (keyed by id) and referenced everywhere else by JSON-pointer (e.g. "#/assessment/pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_PRD"). This deduplicates the recursive VA-Spec 1.1.0 Statement tree into a flat, addressable graph.
_variant: PVS-v19-TP53 — TP53 c.641A>T (p.His214Leu). Source tab: 'TP53'. Companion to pkp2 (the null/NMD-gating exemplar); this one showcases the MISSENSE (MIS) workflow.
_why_this_variant: Missense with BOTH in-silico (BayesDel) and functional evidence, so it exercises the full MIS sub-tree: BayesDel initial points x exon-relevance multiplier -> MIS_PRD, functional assay -> MIS_FXN, the MIS_PRD_FXN combination CAP (predictive +2 and functional +4 both point damaging, so they corroborate and are capped at +4 rather than summed to +6), plus MIS_INF same-residue comparator (+1). The gene-disease-validity gate is MET here (TP53-Li-Fraumeni = Definitive), the opposite of pkp2's not_met gate. Final: HOD 0 + PFD (MIS +5) -> Likely Pathogenic. Scoring is illustrative; authority lives in CSpec.

svc:PFD.name: SVCv4 Predictive & Functional Data roll-up
svc:PFD._note: The registry currently exposes this same node under CODE `PRD`; recommend aligning the code to `PFD`.

svc:MIS.name: SVCv4 Missense variant roll-up (selected PFD lane)

svc:MIS_PRD_FXN.name: SVCv4 Missense predictive + functional (combination cap)
svc:MIS_PRD_FXN._role: COMBINATION CAP — predictive and functional evidence corroborate the same effect, so their combined weight is capped rather than summed (prevents double-counting one biological signal).

svc:MIS_PRD.name: SVCv4 Single-amino-acid change prediction (BayesDel x exon relevance)

svc:MIS_PRD_INIT_INSILICO.name: SVCv4 in-silico predictor initial points (tool selected in params)

svc:MIS_PRD_EXON_REL.name: SVCv4 Exon relevance (missense) — multiplier on predictor points

svc:GDV.name: SVCv4 Gene-disease validity gate
svc:GDV._role: GATE — a standalone met/not_met assessment. The predictive lane is only counted when the gene-disease relationship is at least Moderate. Referenced by the scored line as one of its `hasEvidenceItems`; its outcome (met/not_met) signals whether that line counts. (Proposed gate methodType — pending the gate-model registry work.)

pvs-v19-tp53:POP_FRQ.description: Population allele frequency (POP_FRQ): FAF/DAFT fold = 0.33 lands in the NONE band. FAF below DAFT — no benign-frequency evidence, no rarity adjustment. Neutral (POP_FRQ_+0).

hasEvidenceItems.description: Filtering allele frequency (FAF) — the observed population frequency input.

value.source: gnomAD v4.1 joint — popmax filtering allele frequency (95% CI upper bound); 1 allele

hasEvidenceItems.description: Disease allele-frequency threshold (DAFT) — max credible population AF for Li-Fraumeni via TP53.
Computed FAF/DAFT fold and the band it selects (fold value + band choice combined).

value.fold_definition: FAF / DAFT — observed filtering AF relative to the disease allele-frequency threshold
value._note: Illustrative band ranges/points — authoritative thresholds live in CSpec.

pvs-v19-tp53:POP.description: Population observation roll-up (POP_FRQ + POP_HMZ). Only POP_FRQ applies here.

pvs-v19-tp53:HOD.description: Human Observational Data roll-up (POP + CLN + LOC). No clinically diagnosed probands or segregation data supplied for this VBC, so CLN and LOC contribute nothing. HOD = POP = 0.

pvs-v19-tp53:GDV.description: Gene-disease validity gate for the predictive lane. MET: TP53-Li-Fraumeni syndrome is a Definitive gene-disease relationship (ClinGen), so predictive missense evidence is eligible to be counted.

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_PRD_INIT_INSILICO.description: BayesDel predictor initial points. BayesDel 0.32 lands in the +2 (PATH_MODERATE) band -> +2 initial predictive points (before exon-relevance scaling).

hasEvidenceItems.description: In-silico predictor score and the band it selects.

value._note: BayesDel band cut-points from SM 6 Fig 2; authoritative thresholds live in CSpec.

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_PRD_EXON_REL.description: Exon-relevance multiplier applied to the BayesDel initial points. p.His214 sits in the TP53 DNA-binding domain (a mutational hotspot, high clinical relevance) and is in MANE Select -> full weight, multiplier 1.0. Gated on gene-disease validity (#/assessment/pvs-v19-tp53:GDV = met).

hasEvidenceItems.description: Exon-relevance input and the resulting multiplier.

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_PRD.description: Single-amino-acid change prediction = BayesDel initial points (+2) x exon-relevance multiplier (1.0) = +2.0.

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_FXN.description: Missense functional assay. Multiple orthogonal assays (yeast + human cell lines) show loss of transactivation and loss of growth suppression; the TP53 VCEP combines them to a strong damaging call -> +4.0.

value.assay_result: non-functional: loss of transactivation and loss of growth suppression (yeast + human cell lines)
value.vcep: TP53 VCEP combines 3 LoF assay outputs

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_PRD_FXN.description: Predictive + functional COMBINATION CAP. Predictive (MIS_PRD +2) and functional (MIS_FXN +4) both indicate a damaging effect — one biological signal corroborated two ways. Rather than summing to +6, the combined weight is capped at the strong ceiling of +4 (set by the functional lane). This is why the two lanes roll into one capped node before the informative tally is added.

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS_INF.description: Informative same-residue comparator (PM5-type). A different missense at the same residue, p.His214Arg (ClinVar:376615), is Pathogenic (TP53 VCEP); the VBC change p.His214Leu is less conservative (Grantham 99 vs 29) -> +1 supporting.

hasEvidenceItems.description: Same-residue comparator variant and its classification tier.

value.rule: same residue, comparator P/LP and VBC change no more conservative -> supporting

pvs-v19-tp53:MIS.description: Missense roll-up (selected PFD lane) = MIS_PRD_FXN (+4, capped predictive+functional) + MIS_INF (+1, same-residue comparator) = +5.0.

pvs-v19-tp53:PFD.description: Predictive & Functional Data roll-up. MIS is the selected family for this variant; PFD = MIS = +5.0. Shown as the parent even though only the MIS lane applied.

variation._note: Placeholder VRS Variation. Source: ClinGen Allele ID CA16603036.

pvs-v19-tp53.description: Final SVCv4 classification. HOD (0.0) + the selected PFD lane MIS (+5.0) = +5.0 -> Likely Pathogenic. The MIS workflow carried the call: moderate BayesDel prediction (+2) and strong functional data (+4) corroborated (capped at +4), plus a same-residue Pathogenic comparator (+1), all downstream of a met gene-disease-validity gate.
